propositions: Closing a ticket invokes _compact_on_close which acquires the store write lock and holds it for minutes (up to 13m53s measured) while performing fold, authorship ledger, snapshot write, and git operations, blocking concurrent writes from other agents.

The store lock hold during compaction is unbounded and stacks with nested advisory git operation locks (_store_git_op_lock, _STORE_GIT_LOCK_WAIT_S=30s, _INDEX_LOCK_ATTEMPTS=10) that can each timeout, causing other agents to exhaust their acquire budget.
Compaction is optional housekeeping and not required for correctness; the event log is valid uncompacted and replays identically through the reducer.

The fix removes _compact_on_close and its call site from the close path, restoring close lock holds to seconds by eliminating the only unbounded holder; compaction remains available via explicit rebar compact <id> command and scheduled out-of-band triggers.
